title: Deep Merge Two Configs
statement: Read two JSON objects (flat, one key-value per top-level key) on two lines. Print the merged object as JSON where the second object's values override the first's for matching keys, with keys sorted alphabetically. Format: key1=val1,key2=val2 (comma-separated, no spaces).
starter_code:
import json
a = json.loads(input())
b = json.loads(input())
# TODO: merge b into a (b wins on conflicts), print sorted key=value pairs
hints: {**a, **b} merges two dicts with b's keys taking priority on conflicts
